identity_encoding.rename_rule: Display names do not form identity.
identity_encoding.authority_rule: Source, subject, type, and data do not grant authority.

bus_selection.type_selection: upstream exact and wildcard Router paths

handler_precedence: matching message patterns in registration order
handler_isolation: Membership and other non-message facts use their own Signal type routes. They cannot enter message or mention handlers.
resource_lifetime: call-local; owner-bound; explicit cancellation and expiry; no restart-safe replay
delivery_rule: Validate the complete ordered Signal list and all limits before authoritative processing. A breach rejects the complete delivery.

resources.ownership: The call owner and binding key are checked. The reference never carries bytes, a local path, client, PID, function, or lazy stream.
resources.lifetime: Binding-owned local storage; explicit expiry/cancel/failure; no restart-safe replay.

retained_records_note: Domain records and builders remain separate. Public communication wrappers, raw provider payload kinds, and legacy event mirrors are removed.

binding_options.private_provider_options: Remaining keyword options are captured once by configure_binding/1. They never enter Signal data.
required_adapter_callbacks: normalize_event/2 accepting binding and private provider request
binding_options.startup_rule: Reject missing/wrong protocol or callback contracts before listeners start.

handler_api.on: Jido.Chat.Handlers.on(handler_value, exact_fact_module, callback, mode: fact|message|mention|subscribed, pattern: regex)
handler_api.handle: Jido.Chat.Handlers.handle(handler_value, fact) -> {:ok, updated_value, observation_result}; callback failure returns {:error, Contract, claimed_value}
handler_api.ownership: Keep the returned claimed value after callback failure. The native Router selects exact fact targets; application policy decides message precedence; native Dispatch observes the unchanged Signal.

acceptance_failure_rule: A failed read-only membership lookup returns Contract handler_failed, releases its item claim, and emits no observation. Private message/lifecycle store error values are converted to handler_failed. Previously accepted items in a partial unit remain claimed; retry preserves order without repeating their observations.

new_fields.until_date: nonnegative integer; zero retains the provider forever value

membership_restrictions.scope: Portable previous/current membership evidence only. It cannot change canonical grants, membership, or presence.
